seo.title: 30 Essential Tools for Solana Developers
seo.description: A curated list of development tools for Solana developers covering Anchor, testing, NFTs, and DeFi development on Solana.

content.intro: Solana development requires specialized tooling for the account model and Rust-based programs. Here are the essential tools for building on Solana.

sections.heading: Development Frameworks
sections.description: Core frameworks for Solana program development.

items.name: Anchor
items.description: The standard framework for Solana development. Rust macros that simplify program development significantly.

items.name: Solana CLI
items.description: Official command-line tools for deployment, testing, and account management.

items.name: Poseidon
items.description: Python-based Solana development framework. Write Solana programs in Python syntax.

items.name: Native Solana SDK
items.description: Low-level SDK for maximum control and optimization. Free and open-source.

sections.heading: Client Libraries
sections.description: Libraries for interacting with Solana from applications.

items.name: @solana/web3.js
items.description: Official JavaScript/TypeScript SDK. Essential for frontend dApps.

items.name: Solana.py
items.description: Python client for Solana. Good for scripts and backend services.

items.name: Anchor TS Client
items.description: TypeScript client generated from Anchor IDL. Type-safe program interactions.

items.name: Solana Rust Client
items.description: Official Rust client for building Solana tooling and services.

sections.heading: NFT Development
sections.description: Tools for building NFTs on Solana.

items.name: Metaplex
items.description: NFT standard and tooling for Solana. Candy Machine, metadata, and more.

items.name: Candy Machine v3
items.description: Latest version of Metaplex's minting infrastructure with guards for custom mint logic.

items.name: Bubblegum
items.description: Compressed NFTs on Solana. Dramatically cheaper for large collections.

items.name: Sugar CLI
items.description: Command-line tool for Candy Machine deployment and management.

items.name: Umi
items.description: Metaplex's modular framework for building Solana clients. Free and open-source. Active open-source project on GitHub.

items.name: Bankrun
items.description: Fast Solana program testing without spinning up a validator.

items.name: Solana Test Validator
items.description: Local validator for integration testing. Free and open-source.

items.name: Anchor Testing
items.description: Built-in testing framework in Anchor using Mocha. Free and open-source.

items.name: Trident
items.description: Fuzzing framework for Anchor programs. Worth evaluating for your workflow.

sections.heading: DeFi Building Blocks
sections.description: Programs and SDKs for DeFi development.

items.name: SPL Token
items.description: Standard token program for Solana. Fungible and non-fungible tokens.

items.name: Token-2022
items.description: Next-gen token program with transfer hooks, fees, and confidential transfers.

items.name: Jupiter SDK
items.description: DEX aggregator SDK. Best prices across Solana DEXes. Free and open-source.

items.name: Raydium SDK
items.description: SDK for Raydium AMM integration. Check the GitHub repo for documentation and examples.

items.name: Pyth SDK
items.description: Price oracle integration for Solana. High-frequency price updates.

items.name: Helius
items.description: Solana RPC with enhanced APIs for NFTs, tokens, and transactions.

items.name: QuickNode Solana
items.description: Reliable Solana RPC with good performance. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Triton
items.description: Dedicated Solana RPC infrastructure. Worth evaluating for your workflow.

items.name: GenesysGo
items.description: Shadow Drive and RPC services for Solana. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

sections.heading: Debugging and Monitoring
sections.description: Tools for debugging and monitoring Solana programs.

items.name: Solana Explorer
items.description: Official block explorer. Transaction details and account inspection.

items.name: Solscan
items.description: Alternative explorer with better UX for some use cases. Free and open-source.

items.name: Anchor IDL Explorer
items.description: Interact with Anchor programs directly via browser. Free and open-source.

items.name: Jito
items.description: MEV infrastructure for Solana. Bundle transactions for better execution.

proTips.tip: Start with Anchor for most projects. Drop to native Solana only when you need maximum optimization.
Use Bankrun for unit tests. It's much faster than spinning up a local validator.
Understand the account model deeply. Most Solana bugs come from incorrect account handling.
Use Helius or similar enhanced RPCs. The standard public endpoints are rate-limited.
Read program logs in explorer when debugging. They tell you exactly what went wrong.
